'''2001 Roseville Enduro Reflections II Booster Draft''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft held at A-1 Comics, Roseville, CA on 11 March 2001. It is known from Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1891">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-13-enduro-rd-3-roseville-ca-3-11-01d1891/ enduro-rd-3-roseville-ca-3-11-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 13 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-13-enduro-rd-3-roseville-ca-3-11-01d1891/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Roseville Enduro]].

* '''Date:''' 11 March 2001
* '''Site:''' A-1 Comics, Roseville, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 20
